english_translations.sahih_international: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
english_translations.pickthall: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
english_translations.yusuf_ali: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
english_translations.shakir: And when the Quran is recited to them they do not make obeisance?
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: Why, when the Quran is recited to them, do they not prostrate themselves?
english_translations.mohsin_khan: And when the Quran is recited to them, they fall not prostrate,
english_translations.arberry: and when the Koran is recited to them they do not bow?

ayahs.conventional_en: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
ayahs.conventional_bn: আল্লাহ খুব ভাল করেই জানেন তারা (তাদের অন্তরে) কী লুকিয়ে রাখে।

ayahs.conventional_en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

english_translations.sahih_international: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
english_translations.pickthall: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
english_translations.shakir: Except those who believe and do good; for them is a reward that shall never be cut off.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: except the righteously striving believers, who will receive a never-ending reward.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).
english_translations.arberry: except those that believe, and do righteous deeds -- theirs shall be a wage unfailing.
